newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek defence industries eye flotation - minister.
newsitem.headline: Greek defence industries eye flotation - minister.

text.p: Defence Minister Akis Tsohatzopoulos said on Tuesday that the government planned to float Greece's state defence industries on the Athens bourse to help boost the domestic arms industry.

"Greek arms industries account for only 4.0 percent of the needs of our armed forces... we want to increase this and the goal is to have these companies listed on the Athens bourse," the minister said at a foreign press luncheon in Athens.
He did not give any details as to which companies would be floated or when. Greece's main arms industries are Pyrkal, EBO and Hellenic Aerospace Industry (EAB).
Defence ministry sources told Reuters that the target was for Greek companies to provide 11 percent of the armed forces needs in armaments.
Tsohatzopoulos said that a 15 billion dollar arms programme for the next decade will be finalised by the end of the year. --Costas Paris, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
